items.label: ✦Elastic Waist & Side Pockets
items.value: This A-line sundress features an elastic waist with gentle pleats that flatter your figure and subtly hide the tummy. Two hidden side pockets are roomy enough to hold your phone or keys, keeping your hands free while maintaining the dress's elegant, flowy silhouette.

items.label: ✦Crew Neck & Wide Strap Design
items.value: These sleeveless maxi dresses feature a classic crew neck and wide tank straps that offer comfortable, modest coverage. The wide straps conceal bra straps perfectly and create a flattering, balanced silhouette that complements all body shapes.

items.label: ✦Wardrobe Essential for Any Occasion
items.value: Effortlessly pair this boho dress with sandals for a relaxed summer vibe or heels and jewelry for an elegant evening look. Perfect for beach vacations, resort wear, cruises, travel, brunch, pool days, casual parties, or everyday wear. Layer with a denim jacket or cardigan in air-conditioned rooms for added comfort.

items: ✦Please refer to the WIHOLL Size Chart before Ordering these beach vacation clothes. This maxi dress features a long length and relaxed fit. On petite frames, it may run long and loose; for a more fitted look, consider sizing down. Any other questions, please contact us anytime!

items.label: ✦Ideal Surprise Choice
items.value: This spring and summer dress is an ideal choice for your friends and family, sure to bring a delightful surprise!

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: ✦PLEASE NOTE: Due to vacuum packaging, the dresses may arrive with slight wrinkles, which can be easily smoothed out after washing or ironing. Care Instructions: Machine or hand wash in cold water, hang or line dry, no bleach, no dry cleaning, and iron on low heat if necessary.
